name: A European Town Meeting on Climate Change (Tuscany, Italy)
content: Problems and Purpose The main issue at stake was climate change and the actions to prevent it.Session 1: Which energies for tomorrow’s Europe?Session 2 How to reduce our energetic consumption?Session 3: Waste.Session 4: Mobility.Session 5: which strategies to promote Eolic energy?Background History and Context Organizing, Supporting, and Funding Entities This mini-public was supported by Tuscany Region, Cornellà de Llobregat and Poitiers. Participant Recruitment and Selection Participatnts were selected at minimum if they reside in one of the three regions (Tuscany, Poitou-Charentes, Catalonia) and if they were under 30 (3.69% of the participants were over 30). Methods and Tools Used What Went On: Process, Interaction, and Participation The town meeting was held in five Tuscany cities and two other cities, one located in Spain (Cornellà de Lobregat) and one in France (Poitiers). The event also included two virtual roundtables composed of young citizens from around Europe.Influence, Outcomes, and Effects Analysis and Lessons Learned See Also References External Links Notes This entry is based on the POLITICIZE dataset.
